_metadata.variable: lwe_thickness: terrestrial total water storage (TWS) anomaly in cm of liquid water equivalent relative to the 2004-2009 mean. TWS includes groundwater, soil moisture, surface water, snow/ice and vegetation water; it is NOT groundwater alone.
_metadata.grid_sampling: Native JPL mascon_ID mapped on the 0.5-degree CRI grid; districts grouped by mascon_ID
_metadata.grid_sampling_note: The 0.5-degree CRI grid is a display/interpolation grid. The product attributes state the native resolution is 3-degree equal-area mascons; the uncertainty field is per mascon, not per 0.5-degree cell. All 0.5-degree cells inside one mascon carry the same TWS value.
_metadata.area_pct_method: ADM0 subpixel intersection (10x10 subpixels per 0.5-degree cell, cos-lat area weights)
_metadata.area_pct_note: Percentage of each mascon total 0.5-degree cell area inside the HDX/OCHA COD-AB ADM0 Bangladesh polygon. A 0.5-degree cell is counted by 10x10 subpixel intersection; areas are weighted by cos(latitude).

gap.note: GRACE ended in 2017 and GRACE-FO science data resume in 2018; no values are interpolated.

_metadata.deseasonalization: Mean seasonal cycle removed before trend fitting: for each calendar month the long-term mean TWS anomaly is subtracted across all valid years.
_metadata.trend_method: Ordinary least squares on monthly deseasonalised TWS anomaly versus decimal year; slope in cm/year with standard error. Raw (seasonal) slopes are also stored for reference.
_metadata.spatial_note: Regional basin-scale total water storage change, not field-level groundwater. Neighbouring districts in the same mascon share one observation; district-level trends would be statistically false and are not reported.
